name: recoil_version_get_string
description: RecoilVersion::GetString returns the retail version string used by startup UI and registry setup.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x438980 passed using VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 for 80x86 with profile vc5_o2_ob0_facs and flags /nologo /TP /W3 /G5 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs /I .

COFF byte comparison for ?GetString@RecoilVersion@@YAPBDXZ had zero unmasked byte mismatches against Binary Ninja 0x438980 after relocation masking; byte diff, relocation mask, triage, normalized asm diff, listing, and object artifacts were emitted under build/vc5-verify/recoil_version_get_string/verify.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly at 0x438980 moves the address of the retail string "1.0" into eax and returns; HLIL renders this as return "1.0" with no warnings.
The native smoke calls RecoilVersion::GetString and verifies it returns a non-null pointer to the exact "1.0" string.
